description: Make the scene playable (call logic.get_guide first): variables, rules (when click/key/button/timer/start -> if -> actions), HUD text and buttons, cursor mode, start/restart
name: logic

tools.description: READ FIRST: how to turn a scene into a playable game with variables, rules, UI and start/restart.
tools.name: logic.get_guide

tools.description: Define game variables and their starting values (start/restart resets to these).

vars.description: {name: starting value} (number, text, bool, list, map)

tools.name: logic.define_vars

tools.description: Change a variable while the game runs (fires var_changed rules).
tools.name: logic.set_var

tools.description: Evaluate an expression against the current variables (test conditions and functions).
tools.name: logic.eval

tools.description: Add or replace rules (by name): when <on> [target/key/filter] and <condition> then <actions>.

rules.description: Rules: {name, on, target, key, filter, condition, actions:[...], enabled}

tools.name: logic.define_rules

tools.description: All rules with their full definitions.
tools.name: logic.list_rules

tools.description: Attach data to a node (and its children); click rules read it as event.data.

target.description: Target: node id (n12), path (a/b), actor:Name, or object path

tools.name: logic.set_data

tools.description: Add or replace on-screen text and buttons. Text is a live template: 'Score: {score}'. Buttons fire 'button' rules.

items.description: Items: {name, kind: text|button, text, anchor:[x,y] 0-1, size:[w,h], color:[r,g,b,a], background, font_size, visible_if}

tools.name: logic.define_ui

tools.description: cursor: visible mouse cursor, clicks hit objects and buttons (board/puzzle games). game: normal play/fly.

lock_camera.description: Stop mouse-look and movement (fixed board view)

tools.name: logic.set_input_mode

tools.description: Start or restart the game: reset variables, remove objects made during play, clear timers, run 'start' rules.
tools.name: logic.start

tools.description: Simulate player input to test the game: a click on a node, a key, a button press or a custom event.
tools.name: logic.fire_event

tools.description: Advance game time for timers and tick rules (testing).
tools.name: logic.step

tools.description: Running state: variables, timers, rules, UI, objects made in play, and the recent event log with errors.
tools.name: logic.get_state

tools.description: The whole game definition (vars, rules, ui, node data, input mode) as JSON.
tools.name: logic.export

tools.description: Replace the game definition with one from logic.export.
tools.name: logic.import
